rv.q: Having enjoyed North Coast Rep’s staging only a few years ago, I found this production every bit as entertaining and recommend it highly.
The laughs were nonstop, resulting in a great time at the theatre.
SRT’s latest is a witty tribute to the arts with strong performances and direction from Williams.

All plays of this style require steady pacing, humor and buoyancy to keep the laughs rolling, and "Theatre People" achieves it, thanks to good direction by Williams and the talented "theater people" in its cast.

cn.t: Critics praise this screwball comedy as a laugh-filled crowd-pleaser, with standout set design and strong performances delivering fast-paced fun that pokes affectionate fun at the theater world.
